services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short: Shingle and metal roof installs, repairs and replacements.
services.text: Complete roof installations, repairs, and replacements for homes of all sizes. We specialize in shingle and metal roofing.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Low-sloped TPO and pitched metal roof systems.
services.text: Professional roofing solutions for commercial properties, including 1–4 story buildings, retail and multi-family developments.
body: Specializing in low sloped TPO and pitched metal roof systems.

services.title: Storm Damage Repair & Replacements
services.short: Fast and reliable storm damage assessment and repairs.
services.text: Fast and reliable storm damage assessment and repairs. We work with our customers and the insurance companies to simplify the claims process.

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.short: Find potential issues before they become costly problems.
services.text: Comprehensive roof inspections to identify potential issues before they become costly problems.

services.title: Metal Roofing
services.short: Standing seam and PBR metal panel systems.
services.text: Standing seam and PBR metal roof systems for homes and commercial buildings. Metal panels designed for performance and looks, for a durable finish.
body: Standing seam metal roofing is a concealed fastener metal panel system that features vertical legs and a broad, flat area between the two legs.
PBR metal roofing and metal siding panels are an ideal solution for pre-engineered metal buildings, post-frame, and agricultural buildings, and come in several energy-efficient colors.
points: PBR metal roofing and siding panels

about.title: About Houston Roofing Experts
text: Houston Roofing Experts is a family-owned roofing company, serving the Houston and surrounding areas for over 16 years. We are dedicated to providing superior residential and commercial roofing solutions. Founded on integrity, we provide high-quality workmanship and products, ensuring that we follow our unique quality process and never take shortcuts. We stand behind our work, offering total transparency, and treating every roof like we would like to be treated if it was going to be installed on our own home.

Our vision is to establish Houston Roofing Experts as the region's household name for roofing. We strive to be the first choice for Houston families and businesses, recognized for setting the industry standard in quality craftsmanship and trusted service.

To set the Houston Roofing Experts standard for roofing excellence by combining premium materials with expert installation techniques. We are dedicated to delivering superior quality and excellent customer service, ensuring every client feels confident in their investment for years to come.
